name: Adam
overview: Scripture presents Adam as the first man, uniquely formed by God from the dust and given life by His breath, created in God's image with dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:26; 2:7). God placed Adam in the Garden of Eden with freedom to eat from every tree except one, but Adam and Eve disobeyed by eating the forbidden fruit, bringing sin and its consequences into the world (Genesis 2:16; 3:6, 17). Adam’s role as the progenitor of the human race is underscored by naming Eve the mother of all living (Genesis 3:20), and his life and fall serve as a foundational type pointing toward Christ.
